headline: Real Dough week 40 units fell 49% to 5,042 as selling-store count and velocity both contracted, while Festival Foods and other accounts retained strong four-week momentum and Kroger added more kid-focused frozen handhelds.

items: Festival Foods led four-week account gains with 3,525 units, up 188% from the prior four weeks; Sendik's rose 84%, Piggly Wiggly 53% and Cub Foods 50%.
Heinen's entered the pulse with 24 units across three stores, and Ken's Foods entered with 16 units at one store.
The current pulse lists 19 new-store records, including ten Kroger Michigan stores, one Cub Foods store, one Walmart store, three Heinen's stores and one Ken's Foods store.
Real Dough sold 5,042 units in week 40 (2026-09-27 through 2026-10-03), down 49% from 9,979 in week 39 and 40% below the eight-week average of 8,453; selling stores fell from 521 to 365.
Week 40 velocity was 3.32 units per store per week, down 23% from 4.31 in week 39 and 17% below the 13-week average of 4.01.
The sales pulse flags 142 quiet stores, led by Piggly Wiggly (22), Schnucks (20), unlisted independents (15) and Hy-Vee (10); these are source-defined quiet-store records, not confirmed delistings.
Four-week units fell 89% at Coborns Marketplace, 70% at Kroger Michigan, 69% at Super One, and 61% at both Kroger Mariano's and Kowalski's versus the prior four weeks.

Kroger's freezer assortment added two family-focused signals this week: nationwide Incredifulls PAW Patrol PB&J Cups using a sourdough-brioche format and two additional Red's kid-sized mini-burrito varieties.
Reconcile week 40's 49% unit decline and 156-store selling-count contraction against distribution, inventory, order timing and promotion records before treating it as a demand change.
Prioritize store-level follow-up on the 142 quiet stores and the five steepest four-week account declines, starting with Coborns, Kroger Michigan, Super One, Kroger Mariano's and Kowalski's.
Document the promotion and distribution drivers behind Festival Foods, Sendik's, Piggly Wiggly and Cub Foods before carrying those gains into buyer materials.
For Kroger selling, define the exact family meal occasion Real Dough wins and monitor whether portable, kid-focused frozen items are taking incremental or substitutive freezer space.

agency_brief.what_worked: The defensible positive proof is four-week account momentum at Festival Foods, Sendik's, Piggly Wiggly and Cub Foods, plus initial sales at Heinen's and Ken's Foods.
agency_brief.what_didnt: No current paid, social or content-performance feed is available, so no campaign or creative winner can be identified. Operationally, week 40 units, selling-store count and velocity all declined sharply.
agency_brief.recommendation: Keep near-term communications anchored in a clearly defined family meal occasion and validated retailer proof. Do not use the week 40 decline or four-week account gains as demand conclusions until distribution, inventory, timing and promotion are reconciled.
agency_brief.competitive_context: Kroger is expanding sharply occasion-led frozen handhelds: Incredifulls uses licensed characters, sourdough-brioche and multiple preparation modes, while Red's is extending established flavors into exclusive kid-sized formats. The shelf implication is that premium quality alone is not enough; format and use occasion need to be explicit.
